content:
Coming off an antidepressant should always be done under medical supervision because withdrawal symptoms can occur and vary in severity between individuals. A doctor can guide you through a gradual tapering process to minimize withdrawal effects, which can include dizziness, nausea, insomnia, mood swings, or anxiety.

Because of this, I would strongly advise you to consult with your doctor before making any changes. They can provide personalized advice and monitor your health during the transition.
